purpose: Teach: 帯域/ファクター/環境省/入所/税務署/経済企画庁/自治省/付随

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、通信帯域の確保に苦労された
lines.en: Father, when we were founding the company, you struggled hard to secure communication bandwidth.
lines.style: Measured, respectful acknowledgment. Slight pause before the concrete example. Tone of genuine curiosity about the strategic choice. Not seeking approval, just understanding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは成功ファクターを見抜かれた
lines.en: Yes. Father saw what the real success factor was.
lines.style: Steady, affirming. Light emphasis on the insight itself—not the struggle, but the clarity. A son confirming his father understood something essential. Quiet pride in that vision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、環境省の創設前から環境対応をされた
lines.en: Father, you were already thinking about environmental responsibility, even before the ministry was established.
lines.style: Soft wonder in the opening. Slight vocal lift on the realization—ahead of the times. Respectful pause. Not surprised, but moved by the foresight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員寮の入所制度を整えられた
lines.en: Yes. Father built the employee dormitory system with real care and structure.
lines.style: Grounded, reflective. Gentle on 'built'—suggesting deliberate craftsmanship. A son naming something his father did well. Understated warmth, no flourish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、税務署と良好な関係を保たれた
lines.en: Father, you maintained such good relations with the tax office all those years.
lines.style: Thoughtful exhale at the start. Appreciating the patience and diplomacy this required. Voice lingers slightly on the relationship itself, not the transaction. Wistful for that kind of steadiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経済企画庁の指針を参考にされた
lines.en: Yes. Father took guidance from the Economic Planning Agency and applied it wisely.
lines.style: Calm acknowledgment. Slight pause between the agency and the action—showing how father translated principle into practice. Not boasting, just naming something real and careful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、自治省時代の人脈で地方展開された
lines.en: Father, you expanded into the regions using the connections you'd built during your time at the autonomous administration.
lines.style: Voice opens with appreciation. Soft emphasis on the word 'connections'—recognizing the long-term relationship-building. Wistful for that kind of strategic patience and local knowledge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは主事業に付随する周辺事業も育てられた
lines.en: Yes. Father didn't just grow the core business—he nurtured the adjacent businesses around it.
lines.style: Calm, final observation. Slight warmth on 'nurtured'—suggesting care, not mere growth. This is a son seeing his father whole, at the end. Slow, deliberate, holding space for what was built.
